criteria.description: Multi-line link resolves after --apply on the fixture
criteria.note: linkPass edits at targetLine ?? openLine. scanLinks adds targetLine at doc-links.js:187-189, tested at doc-links.test.mjs:987. Both test files are in the 'shared/resources/tests/*.test.mjs' glob of test:suite, which test.yml runs on every pull_request.

criteria.description: Dangling link left by the tool printed with file and line
criteria.note: deadLinks entries carry file and line (targetLine ?? line). The text output printing is pinned by the test at 2788, which covers warnings and skipped files.

criteria.description: Retired epic-registry stub contains no link
criteria.note: epicRegistryPointer writes code spans, not links.

criteria.description: --apply refuses dirty tree and branch behind upstream
criteria.note: The dirty-tree and behind-upstream warnings are turned into blockers under --apply. Guards are at 2630 and 2681. The controls test at 2698 covers no upstream, an upstream deleted on the remote, and an unreachable upstream.
A generated file is skipped and listed. inRewriteScope also refuses it (test at 2805).

criteria.description: Tracked script with legacy pattern listed in closing line
criteria.note: The closing line reads 'N repo files still hard-code legacy names: ...'.

criteria.description: Post-apply scans read each tracked file once; read counter asserted
criteria.note: scanTracked has one io.readFile per file, shared by the link, old-path and legacy-name scans. The test wraps readFile with a counter and asserts n === 1 per path. See the advisory: the test calls scanTracked with applied:false.

criteria.description: Tests, npm test, npm run bundle:check pass
criteria.note: The only evidence is that the test suite and bundle:check run clean. validate.yml:128 runs bundle:check. QA 1-3 record 'npm run bundle:check # 128 skills, 0 problems' as an extra reading, but the grade comes from CI reading 1.

criteria.description: Each fix's test goes red when the fix is reverted (QA report)

members.member: QA bug 1 behind guard fails open

criteria.note: Process criterion. The committed mutation-proof table (rows at lines 11-28) gives a revert and the red test for each unit. QA gate 3 reports PASS 100 and qa.3:93 re-confirms the bug 2 mutation. One row (the new-scheme exclusion in gap 7, line 20) records 'no test went red', and the code was deleted, not kept. That leaves no fix needing a test, so it does not count as an uncovered unit. Gap 3 has no fix.

Documentation criterion. CHANGELOG.md:23 is the entry '(task 253)' and describes all six changes, the behaviour change and the gap 3 non-reproduction. changelog-cites.sh reported 'cites (task 253)' in QA 2 and 3. Its test is in the shared/resources/tests glob and runs per PR.

criteria.description: Gaps that did not reproduce are recorded as such in the QA report
criteria.note: Documentation criterion. qa.1:60 says '**Gap 3 (frontmatter validation) did not reproduce.**' and gives the evidence and the dropped fix. qa.1:54 and qa.3:31 repeat it, and the mutation-proof file notes it at its end. Gap 3 is the only gap that did not reproduce.

advisories.note: The read-once test calls scanTracked with applied:false. The link scan (wantsLinks) runs only when applied is true, so the post-apply link path is not exercised by the counter. The code is still one readFile per file (migrate-doc-numbering.mjs:2569), so the criterion holds structurally. A test with applied:true and a touched .md file would assert the post-apply path directly.
